The engine's initialize response carries no agentInfo on this route either; the version named above is the installed bundle's, read from its install record. The command the model ran is the one the capture prompt asked for; rawInput.description is the model's own argument. Reduced at capture: the session id, toolCallId, replayId, turn-end messageId and the executionId / turnId pair are synthetic fixed values, and the workspace path reads as a home-relative placeholder.
